documents.title: Conservation report
documents.text:
Conservation report: Wexcombe Psalter (fictional, authored test material).
For Wexcombe Nordic, a subsidiary, share of palimpsest leaves in FY2024 was 23.2%. Marginal annotations at Wexcombe GmbH stood at 652 in FY2024. Wexcombe Psalter had missing leaves of 8 in FY2025. For Wexcombe Psalter, ruled columns per page in FY2024 was 2 (reported basis). The meaning of the rubric "de gradibus" for Wexcombe Psalter is understood as follows: a reference to ranks of the clergy. As to Wexcombe Psalter, the place of production is: produced in a lay urban workshop.

documents.title: Palaeographic study
documents.text:
Palaeographic study: Wexcombe Psalter (fictional, authored test material).
For Wexcombe Psalter, share of palimpsest leaves in FY2024 was 31.8%. Insured value at Wexcombe Psalter stood at $6.3m with effect from 1 Jan 2025 (reported basis). Wexcombe Psalter had binding date (CE) of 1767 in FY2024. For Wexcombe Psalter, ruled columns per page in FY2024 was 1 (pro forma (including the planned acquisition) basis). The meaning of the rubric "de gradibus" for Wexcombe Psalter is understood as follows: a reference to the gradual psalms.
